title: Cabot Corporation to Increase Prices Globally for Aerogel Products and Thermal Wrap™ Flexible Insulation Blankets
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Cabot Corporation's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
[PDF Version](https://investor.cabot-corp.com/node/27086/pdf)


**BOSTON** – Oct. 1, 2026 – Effective for orders accepted on or after October 15, 2026, or as contracts allow,[Cabot Corporation](https://www.cabotcorp.com/) (NYSE: CBT) will increase prices globally for all Cabot aerogel grades and Thermal Wrap™ flexible insulation blankets. Price increases will be up to 10 percent, depending on product and region.


The price increase is necessitated by continued increases in manufacturing and logistics costs, including energy, transportation, waste gas disposal, wastewater treatment and packaging expenses. These market conditions have increased the cost of producing and supplying aerogel products and insulation solutions globally, requiring a corresponding price adjustment. The price adjustment will help ensure that Cabot remains a reliable, long-term supplier of high-quality aerogel products.


**ABOUT CABOT CORPORATION**


Cabot Corporation (NYSE: CBT) is a global specialty chemicals and performance materials company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. The company is a leading provider of[reinforcing carbons](https://www.cabotcorp.com/solutions/products-plus/carbon-blacks-for-elastomer-reinforcement) ,[specialty carbons](https://www.cabotcorp.com/solutions/products-plus/specialty-carbons) ,[battery materials](https://www.cabotcorp.com/batteries) ,[engineered elastomer composites](https://www.cabotcorp.com/solutions/products-plus/elastomer-composites) ,[inkjet colorants](https://www.cabotcorp.com/solutions/products-plus/inkjet-colorants) ,[masterbatches and conductive compounds](https://www.cabotcorp.com/solutions/products-plus/masterbatches-and-conductive-compounds) ,[fumed metal oxides](https://www.cabotcorp.com/solutions/products-plus/fumed-metal-oxides) and[aerogel](https://www.cabotcorp.com/solutions/products-plus/aerogel) . For more information on Cabot, please visit the company’s website at[cabotcorp.com](https://www.cabotcorp.com/) .
